llm_response.reason: The site uses the domain name of a popular plush toy (Squishmallows) but contains no legitimate Squishmallows content. Instead, it presents unrelated content in another language entirely about 'Happy Socks', and all navigation redirects to a different Austrian sock retailer. The domain was registered only days ago, there is no legitimate contact or company information, and this type of domain squatting and brand spoofing is a classic scam tactic.
